approved: Defence Force Discipline Amendment (RCDVS Implementation and Related Measures No. 1) Bill 2026
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would change military discipline rules following the Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide.
It would amend the Defence Force Discipline Act 1982 to adopt commission recommendations, update how mental health is handled in the system, and add fairness and efficiency measures.
The bill also makes minor changes to several other Acts, including the Defence Act 1903 and the Defence Force Discipline Appeals Act 1955.
Implements key recommendations from the Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide.
Modernises the way mental health is treated in the military justice system.
Introduces fairness, streamlining and efficiency measures to the military discipline framework.
Defence Force personnel involved in disciplinary proceedings and military commanders.

Declared that, unless otherwise ordered, the Defence Force Discipline Amendment (RCDVS Implementation and Related Measures No. 1) Bill 2026 stands referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration after the second-reading debate is adjourned.

Supported the Defence Force Discipline Amendment (RCDVS Implementation and Related Measures No. 1) Bill 2026, which implements recommendations of the Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide and reforms military justice, including victim protections, mental health processes, disciplinary procedures and military police equipment powers.

Debated the Defence Force Discipline Amendment (RCDVS Implementation and Related Measures No. 1) Bill 2026, supporting reforms for victim protection, military justice, mental-health processes, harassment offences, historical homosexual service convictions and summary contraventions; the bill was read a second time and ordered to be reported without amendment.

Presented Selection of Bills Committee Report No. 6 of 2026, recommending immediate referrals of four bills to legislative committees with reporting dates from 17 June to 6 August 2026. Moved amendments referring the National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026 to inquiry and excluding the Competition and Consumer Amendment (Responding to Exceptional Circumstances) Bill 2026 from referral.
